about.title: About IA'ssistant MIrAI
about.desc: LibreOffice extension bringing an AI assistant into Writer and Calc. Select text and use the MIrAI menu to generate, edit, summarize, rephrase or adjust the length of your documents.
about.program: MIrAI Programme — Ministry of the Interior
about.changelog:
• Adjust length — − / + mini-dialog to shorten or expand
• Contextual AI suggestions in the edit dialog
• Calc range analysis with markdown cleanup
• Automated deployment with progressive rollout
• Dual-persona user guide (beginner / expert)
• Robust filtering of LLM reasoning (<think> blocks)
update.title: MIrAI — Update
update.prompt:
MIrAI {version} is ready.

To install it, LibreOffice will close —
you will then reopen it to activate the update.

Install and close now?

(If you choose No, the update will be
offered again later. You can also start it
from the MIrAI → About… menu.)
update.prompt_critical:
A new version of MIrAI ({version})
with important improvements is ready.

To install it, LibreOffice will close —
reopen it afterwards to activate the update.

Install and close now?

(If you choose No, the update will be
offered again later.)
update.activates_at_restart: The update will be activated the next time LibreOffice starts.
update.installed_closing:
The update has been installed.

LibreOffice will close to activate it.
Reopen it afterwards.
update.blocked_body:
The MIrAI {version} update was downloaded and
verified, but its automatic installation was blocked by
the security policy of this computer.

It will not be offered again automatically — you can
install it yourself:

── Manual installation ───────────────────────────
1. Menu  Tools ▸ Extension Manager…
2. If "MIrAI" is already in the list: select it,
   then click "Remove".
3. Click "Add" and select the file:
      {oxt}
4. Accept the license.
5. Close and reopen LibreOffice.

(Removing and adding happen inside LibreOffice — no
administrator rights needed.)
If it fails, contact your support / administrator.
update.blocked_pending_folder: the pending_update folder of your LibreOffice profile
update.blocked_open_folder:
► To open the folder containing the downloaded file,
  click "Yes": the file explorer opens
  directly (no command prompt). "No" simply
  closes this message.

enroll.step1_text:
Your AI assistant for LibreOffice is almost ready!

IA'ssistant helps you write, rephrase, summarize
and enrich your documents with ease.

To enable the AI features, a short secure
enrollment procedure is required.

It only takes a few seconds.
enroll.step2_text:
Click "Open browser" to sign in.

  • Your browser will open the MIrAI sign-in page
  • After signing in, come back to LibreOffice
  • Enrollment happens automatically

Your data stays protected:
the plugin stores no password.
enroll.auth_wait_text:
Your browser is open on the sign-in page.

Sign in, then come back to LibreOffice.
enroll.auth_waiting:
Waiting for sign-in{dots}

Sign in through the browser, then come back.
enroll.cancelled_text:
Authentication was cancelled.

You can try again from the MIrAI menu.
enroll.timeout_text: Timed out. Check the redirect and try again.
enroll.enrolling_text: Registering your device with the MIrAI service...
enroll.done_text:
The AI is built right into your Writer and Calc
documents, available from the MIrAI menu.

Writer:
  • Extend — lengthen your text with the AI
  • Edit — rephrase or correct a selection
  • Summarize — condense a passage
  • Simplify — make a text more accessible

Calc:
  • Transform — apply an instruction to each cell
  • AI formula — generate a formula from a description
  • Analyze — get a summary of your data
  • =PROMPT() — query the AI inside a cell


       MIrAI menu → 📚 Documentation to learn more.
enroll.failed_text:
Enrollment failed.
Reason: {reason}

See the MIrAI menu → 📚 Documentation
for help.

After signing in, come back to LibreOffice.

Do you want to continue?
msg.connection_redirect_short:
You will be redirected to the MIrAI sign-in page.

Do you want to continue?

redirect_uri is not allowed.

Check keycloak_allowed_redirect_uri.
msg.kc_endpoints_missing:
Cannot open the authentication page: Keycloak endpoints are missing.

Check keycloakIssuerUrl / keycloakRealm.
msg.kc_client_id_missing: Cannot open the authentication page: client_id is missing.
msg.kc_redirect_missing:
Cannot open the authentication page: redirect_uri is missing.

Example: http://localhost:28443/callback
msg.kc_expired_body:
The Keycloak login expired before the browser returned.

Expected redirect:
{redirect_uri}

Check the redirect and start Login again.

Do you want to open the preferences to check it?
msg.quota_body:
The request quota for the AI assistant has been reached for now.

Please try again in {delay}.
msg.no_change: No applicable change found in the document.
msg.ask_instead: The model tried to ask a question. Rephrase the request more directly.
msg.no_answer: No response received from the model. Check the token and try again.
msg.no_browser:
No browser could be opened on this computer.

Set a default browser, then try again.
msg.action_unavailable_body:
The "{action}" action is not available here.

Open a Writer or Calc document, then try again.
llm.answer_language: LANGUAGE RULE: you MUST answer in English, unless the task explicitly requires another language (for example a translation).
preset.need_range: First select the range of data to analyze.
preset.need_transform_input: First type the transformation instruction in the prompt.
preset.need_transform_values: No values to transform: select non-empty cells.
preset.transform_too_large: Selection too large for Transform ({rows} rows × {cols} columns): at most {max_rows} rows and {max_cells} cells at a time. Select part of the table.
preset.resized: Text adjusted (~{target} words). Click again to iterate.
preset.done_summarize_replaced: Summary inserted in place of the selection.
preset.done_summarize_document: Summary of the document inserted after the last paragraph.
preset.done_simplify_replaced: Rephrasing inserted in place of the selection.
preset.done_simplify_document: Rephrasing of the document inserted after the last paragraph.
preset.target_changed: The target text changed during generation: nothing was written to the document. The result stays shown above, ready to copy.
preset.question_asked: The model asked a question instead of answering. Try again.
preset.done_analyze_partial: Analysis of the first {rows} of {total} rows written below the selection.
preset.analysis_excerpt: Excerpt analyzed: the first {rows} of {total} rows.
preset.refused_transform: {count} row(s) not written: the result would be a refused formula (see #ERREUR in the column).
preset.skipped_transform: {count} row(s) not written: their source value changed during the run.
preset.refused_analyze: Analysis not written: the generated text would be a refused formula (see #ERREUR below the selection).
sel.no_target: Place the cursor in a paragraph or select some text.
sel.several_ranges: Several passages are selected: select only one, or none to work on the whole document.
suggestion.c_stats: Compute the average and the total
reasoning.empty: The model's reasoning will appear here during the next request.
palette.title: MIrAI — Assistant
palette.prompt_help: Describe what the assistant should do
palette.reasoning_help: See what the model is doing
palette.append_help:
Checked: the result is inserted after the selection, between markers, and the original is kept.
Unchecked: the result replaces the selection.
palette.refuse_document: Open a Writer or Calc document.
palette.tables_only: This document's text is only in tables, which actions on the whole document skip.
palette.headings_and_tables_only: This document contains only headings and tables, which actions on the whole document skip.
palette.rewrite_by_section: Long document: the request is applied piece by piece, section by section, splitting the longest ones.
palette.no_action: ℹ No action on the document — plain text answer only.
palette.document_composed: Text added to the document: {count} paragraph(s). Ctrl+Z to undo.
palette.budget_starved: ⚠ This model spent its entire budget reasoning without producing an answer. The document was not modified. Try a model that reasons less (Settings), or a request targeting part of the document.
palette.unusable: ⚠ Unusable reply — the document was not modified.
palette.err_token: Token expired — MIrAI menu ▸ Settings to sign in again.
palette.err_timeout: The service did not respond in time. Try again shortly.
palette.err_busy: LibreOffice was busy (open dialog?). Try again.
run.err_401: Your workstation is not authenticated with the AI service. Open Settings to sign in again.
run.err_403: Access denied by the relay — configuration is resynchronizing. Try again shortly.
run.err_429: Request quota reached. Please try again shortly.
run.err_network: The AI server is unreachable. Check your network connection and try again.
run.err_empty: The assistant produced nothing. Try again — if it persists, report it.
run.err_truncated: The model's reply was cut off before the end: nothing was written to the document. Try a shorter part.
run.not_converged: The assistant did not converge — try again with a more specific request.
run.applied_not_concluded: The actions were applied to the document, but the assistant did not conclude — check the result before trying again.
analysis.too_short:
Document too short for a structural analysis.
Write a few paragraphs, then reopen this tab.
entry.need_document: Open a Writer or Calc document to use the assistant.
caps.no_tools: This model does not accept tools. Changes will go through a direct path driven by the extension.
caps.no_calls: This model does not use the tools offered to it. Changes will go through a direct path.
caps.no_chains: This model can read the document but does not follow up with writing. Changes will go through a direct path driven by the extension — more reliable.
caps.full: This model chains reading and writing: the agentic mode is fully usable.

callback.close_tab: You can close this tab and return to LibreOffice.
callback.if_stuck: If LibreOffice does not respond, wait a few seconds and run the action again.
callback.no_action: No further action is required here.
